user.title: Connect OpenAirLog
user.description: API key from your OpenAirLog account. Required scopes: flights:read, profile:read, statistics:read.

error.auth: Key invalid, revoked or missing scopes.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

init.title: Times and commute
init.description: Briefing counts as duty and applies only before actual flights. The trip threshold defines how much ground time at base starts a new duty.

codes.title: Duty codes
codes.description: Comma separated. Anything not listed counts as duty.

lufthansa.title: Lufthansa live status (optional)
lufthansa.description: Free access via developer.lufthansa.com — register, create an app, then enter client ID and secret here. Provides delay, cancellation, gate and terminal for the upcoming flight. Only 5 days ahead are available, so it is queried within a window around a flight only. Leave empty to disable.

data.lh_fenster_stunden: Query from how many hours before departure
